description: List the wikis in a workspace, with what each is for, how many pages it holds, how many of those are published, and when anything in it last went live - enough to tell which one holds what you are after without opening them. Narrow with `search`.

search.description: search narrows by name or description.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: list_wikis

approvalRequired.description:
approval_required is true when a page in this wiki needs an approval before
 it goes live.

description.description: description is one line on what the wiki holds.

lastPublished.description:
last_published is when anything in it last went live (YYYY-MM-DD), empty if
 nothing has.

pages.description:
pages is how many pages you can see in it, and published is how many of
 those readers can see - together, whether the wiki is alive.

rootPage.description: root_page is the id of the wiki's root page.

slug.description: slug is the wiki's segment in a page URL.

title: List wikis
